Subject: Proposed compromise language (term, auto-renew, convenience termination)

Karthik / Neha — below is suggested language that I recommend we send as our consolidated position to GreenLine. I’ve tried to preserve commercial flexibility while addressing their procurement concerns. Please review; if you both sign off I’ll send to Olivia with tracked changes.

PROPOSED MSA/ORDER FORM LANGUAGE (redline-ready):

1) Term and Renewal
"Term": The initial Term of the Order Form shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue for an initial period of twelve (12) months (the "Initial Term"). Unless either Party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the expiration of the then-current Term, the Order Form shall automatically renew for additional successive twelve (12) month periods (each a "Renewal Term").

2) Customer Opt-Out Election (exception for Reserved Capacity)
For Reserved Capacity or Dedicated deployment Order Forms, Customer may elect non-renewal by providing written notice at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current Term. For Hosted Pay-As-You-Go Order Forms where no minimum committed capacity is purchased, Customer may terminate at any time upon thirty (30) days' written notice; in such cases Customer will be charged for any usage through the effective date of termination.

3) Termination for Convenience / Transitional Assistance
Either Party may terminate the Order Form for convenience upon providing sixty (60) days' prior written notice to the other Party; provided, however, that for Orders that include prepaid or reserved capacity, Redwood shall provide a pro rata refund for any prepaid but unused committed capacity as of the effective date of termination, less any reasonable ramp-down costs. In the event of Customer convenience termination, Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to provide transitional assistance (data export and handoff) for up to thirty (30) days following the effective date of termination; transitional assistance is chargeable if it exceeds the included thirty (30) day period.

4) Notice Mechanics
All notices required under the Order Form shall be effective upon receipt when delivered by: (a) email to the primary contract address listed on the Order Form, with confirmation of delivery; or (b) certified mail, return receipt requested. Parties may update notice addresses by written notice to the other Party.

Rationale / tradeoffs: 
- Sixty (60) days provides a compromise between GreenLine’s requested 90 days and our operational need to preserve capacity planning for Dedicated pools.
- We retained automatic renewal at 12-month intervals but clarified explicit opt-out mechanics for Reserved Capacity.
- Refunds for prepaid committed capacity are pro rata but allow us to recover documented ramp-down costs — this avoids customers booking and exiting without contribution to provisioning.

Next steps I recommend: 
- If Olivia confirms, I’ll prepare the tracked-change MSA document and the annotated Order Form (Redwood_MSA_annotated.docx) and request final procurement countersignature. 
- Neha: please confirm if the proposed pro rata refund calculation (prepaid days remaining less ramp-down costs) is acceptable commercially or if you want a cap expressed as a percentage.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
